# Navbar

You might say
Put the main sections in the top navigation, and make it clear which page I'm on.

**Keep the brand, main destinations, and key action easy to reach**·A website navbar helps visitors understand where they can go and how to return home. Keep the number of primary links manageable, show the current section when useful, and adapt the menu for smaller screens without hiding essential paths.

## You can say this to an AI Agent

> “
> Use one consistent top navbar for Product, Templates, Pricing, and Blog across the site and highlight the current section. Verify destinations, focus, sticky overlap, and opening and closing the mobile menu.

Navbar**≠**[Header](/vibe-hub/header?lang=en)

[Header](/vibe-hub/header?lang=en) is the complete top page area and can include brand, search, and sign-in. [Navbar](/vibe-hub/navbar?lang=en) is the portion dedicated to primary navigation.
